explication: AAAD is an Android app downloader for third-party Android Auto apps, with in-app installation intended to make them available without root. The README describes the main select-download-install journey, but the corresponding catalog and download implementation is not present in the supplied tree, so that subsystem is represented at its enclosing source directory. The sampled code shows separate PRO purchase, promo-code activation, and license-transfer flows. Some runtime components are unsampled; edges reflect only README statements or relationships visible in the provided source excerpts/index.
